pulse.currentFocus: S357 recovered the cut-off S356 closeout and RELEASED it to production: Worker 8a856192 plus content-lane run 35256380631, production contentLaneHead = origin/main. The Desk flagship, reader-first articles, reactions, the site-wide strip and the first public changelog entry since July are live. Comments ship but are degraded by a pre-existing Supabase credential mismatch, and now say which of the two possible causes it is.
pulse.nextMilestone: Fingerprint the remaining 25 unhashed client scripts (the content lane can never update them) and add a served-vs-repo drift gate for lane-held paths, so the class that kept a deleted fetch alive cannot recur.
blockers: Desk comments are DEPLOYED but non-functional: every thread read answers 503 comments_upstream_failed because the Supabase service-role key is rejected with "Invalid API key". This is the credential-project mismatch tracked since S344 and listed as a release-proof blocker before this release — not caused by the promotion. Founder/provider action (CANON-019): reconcile the service-role credential with project fjnpzjjyhnpmunfoycrp.

25 unhashed client scripts still cannot be updated by the content lane, which holds unhashed .js as executable. Measured on staging: 27 of 171 were serving pre-S356 bytes; two are fixed, the rest are open.

Edge uptime sampler cannot run: Workers Free caps the account at 5 cron triggers and all five belong to other projects. Cloudflare error 10072. Needs a founder to free a slot or move to Workers Paid (billing, CANON-019).
604 pre-S349 uptime rows remain unresolvable — a challenge and a real edge outage are indistinguishable in them now the shape is gone. They are labelled, never re-scored, and age out naturally.
Identity/provider acceptance and scoped credential-owner reconciliation remain unresolved independently of this release.
Human signup acceptance, newsletter arming, Desk cadence, public-member-data and immutable warm-origin choices remain unobserved or undecided.
Field-vitals freshness requires a genuinely fresh RUM cohort; local lab evidence deliberately abstains.

now: [S356][DESK/P1] The Desk publishes real illustrations again — SHIPPED. The publisher never had an image model — art 08-07..08-23 was hand-made, so 25 stories shipped the procedural card. A local Codex worker (ChatGPT plan, no API key) generates it; ingest takes only reviewed images; 25 backfilled (D-S356.1).

[S356][DESK/P1] Article + index redesigned for readers — SHIPPED. Headline/byline/illustration/short-version first, readable persona blocks, receipts folded per fact, image-led index, "Illustration pending" when art is a placeholder.
[S356][DESK/P1] Reactions toggle and diversify — SHIPPED. One pick per bar, tap again to remove, 8 panel emoji, and the floating widget no longer covers the bars.

[S356][DESK/P1] Community comments on every article — BUILT (deploy pending). Anyone may post, automatic filter, members badged and featured; report + auto-hold; moderation CLI; migration + probe ready (D-S356.2).
[S356][DESK/P1] Desk reaches readers everywhere — SHIPPED. Flagship homepage module above the fold and a site-wide header strip that only claims "Live" when the measured cadence is daily.

[S356][DESK/P1] Daily publishing defects fixed — SHIPPED. Authoring runs the checks promote runs, anchors repaired verbatim (with an overlap rule), a missed day fails the late-night run, 7-day novelty, feed-summary facts, 20 verified new sources, same-day follow-up overwrite refused (D-S356.3).

[S356][TRUTH/P1] Studio Pulse tells the truth — SHIPPED. Dormant projects derived from real activity (Solara is no longer "right now in the forge"), studio-wide 7-day timeline with honest partial states, false "stranded deploy" alarm closed.

[S356][SITE/P0] Site-wide crawl: 5 P0 + 13 P1 defects fixed. Sigil covering the mobile menu button on 134 pages, floating widgets covering content on 104+ loads, two production 404s, an unhandled error on /invite/, light-theme contrast, 181 undersized tap targets, /faq/ CLS 0.419→0.003.
next: [S348][SIL][NEWS/AI/P1] Claim-evidence relationship map + agent critique packet — DONE. Every Desk story now links to a deterministic `critique.json` argument map joining stable fact receipts, stances, predictions, and hash-bound visual evidence. Unsupported claims stay explicitly `unlinked`; orphan cross-references fail closed; no runtime model call is made.
